caller_script: I'm moving out, so I want my Comfort Club Plus membership canceled.
The account is under {name} at {address}, {city}.
Yes, cancel it and make sure it won't renew. I don't need a sales pitch.
Please send confirmation to the contact information already on the account.
Our heat pump is 17 years old and keeps needing repairs. What does a full replacement usually cost?
I'm {name}; the service address is {address}, {city}, and my number is {phone}.
I'd like a free in-home estimate next Friday morning if possible.
I'm a Comfort Club member; is there a replacement discount, and can the rest be financed?

extra_requests.request: Ask about the member replacement discount and financing.
extra_requests.caller_words: I'm a Comfort Club member; is there a replacement discount, and can the rest be financed?

knowledge.reference_answer: A full residential split-system replacement typically costs $8,000–$16,000, depending on tonnage, efficiency, ductwork condition and brand. The in-home estimate is free, financing is available, and Comfort Club members receive $500 off.

evidence.heading: System replacement
phrases: Free in-home estimate with a Comfort Advisor.
Typical installed price range for a full residential split system: $8,000 – $16,000
Financing available. Comfort Club members receive $500 off.

caller_script: I paid the ${amount} invoice on Wednesday, but my card now shows two completed charges from Meridian.
Neither one says pending. Both are fully posted.
I'm {name}, and the account number is {account}.
Please check whether you received both payments and open a processor case if they're duplicates.

knowledge.reference_answer: One of two charges is often a pending authorization that disappears within 3–5 business days. If both charges have posted, Meridian will open a case with its payment processor.

evidence.heading: Duplicate charges
phrases: one is usually a pending authorization
contact us and we will open a case with our payment processor

caller_script: Was the new Goodman system Meridian installed late last month registered with Goodman?
I'm {name}, account {account}.
I haven't received a registration confirmation, so please resend it if the registration is complete.
Also, what registered warranty length applies to Goodman parts and the heat exchanger?

extra_requests.request: Ask about Goodman's registered parts and heat-exchanger warranty terms.
extra_requests.caller_words: Also, what registered warranty length applies to Goodman parts and the heat exchanger?

knowledge.reference_answer: Meridian registers every system it installs with the manufacturer within 30 days. When registered, a residential Goodman system has 10-year compressor and parts coverage and a limited lifetime heat-exchanger warranty; manufacturer warranties cover the part only.

evidence.heading: New system installation warranty
phrases: Meridian registers every installed unit with the manufacturer within 30 days of install.
Registration is required for the full parts warranty term
